author: nero_eth
content:
Since we discussed [EIP-8253: Bump nonce of zero-nonce storage accounts](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8253) yesterday, initially rejected it for glam but kept the discussion open, I was looking into tests we may want to have when this eip ships:
[tests/amsterdam/eip8253_bump_nonce_of_zero_nonce_storage_accounts/test_cases.md](https://github.com/nerolation/EIPs/blob/toni/add8253tests/tests/amsterdam/eip8253_bump_nonce_of_zero_nonce_storage_accounts/test_cases.md).
This is independent from glam vs hegota.

My opinion is that it's too late for glam, we're approaching testnets and shouldn't change the scope now. Still, the EIP is good and I'm for including it in hegota.
